$comment: Machine-checkable incremental cost model for the OPTIONAL E5 bounded-autonomy control plane (GitHub issue #440). This file is the single source of truth for docs/operations-e5-cost-notes.md. Tests recompute totals from the model's own rates and reconcile the alarm count against the 09 template. It does not assert that E5 is deployed. Values and identifiers are public-safe (synthetic).

design.autonomy_shape: One scheduled evaluator Lambda + role + log group behind an EventBridge schedule rule, reading a SEPARATE AppConfig autonomy switch plus the E4 kill switch, starting the EXACT existing E3 workflow with an identifier only.
design.notes: E5 adds ONE evaluator Lambda, ONE EventBridge schedule rule, ONE log group, and FOUR alarms on AWS-emitted metrics only (evaluator errors and throttles from AWS/Lambda, scheduled-evaluation delivery failures from AWS/Events, and dead-letter depth from AWS/SQS). It emits NO custom CloudWatch metrics of its own, so no alarm depends on backend instrumentation a default/disabled plane never emits. It provisions NO KMS key (the log group uses default service-managed encryption; the evaluator reuses the 06 CMK via DynamoDB only), NO Secrets Manager secret, and NO API. It creates NO executor and NO new workflow: the single gamelift capacity-write grant remains the unchanged E3 executor role in the 07 stack.

alarms.$comment: The FOUR E5-owned CloudWatch alarms provisioned by 09-operations-autonomy.yaml, all on AWS-emitted metrics. cw_alarms below equals the length of this list; the infra test asserts it equals the number of AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm resources in the template.

custom_metrics.$comment: E5 emits NO custom CloudWatch metrics of its own; its alarms watch AWS-emitted metrics only (AWS/Lambda Errors + Throttles, AWS/Events FailedInvocations, AWS/SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible). The AppConfig autonomy-switch deployment rollback monitor keys off the AWS/Lambda Errors alarm. Autonomy-outcome coverage upstream/downstream is provided by the REUSED E1 (06), E3 (07), and E4 (08) alarms and is billed under those stacks, not double-counted here.

default_unprovisioned.$comment: Provisioned=false: ZERO resources, $0. This is the default.

provisioned_disabled.$comment: Provisioned=true, AutonomyMode=disabled. The EventBridge rule is DISABLED so the evaluator never fires on a timer; the only steady-state cost is the four alarms. No Lambda invocations, no AppConfig retrievals.

enabled_idle.$comment: Provisioned=true, AutonomyMode=operate. The schedule fires the evaluator every 5 minutes (8640/month); each invocation reads the two AppConfig documents through the extension cache and evaluates the policy, but starts no workflow when no change is warranted. Cost is the four alarms + the scheduled Lambda + the AppConfig retrievals.

per_autonomous_action.$comment: One authorized autonomous action starts the EXACT E3 workflow with an identifier only. The workflow + executor cost is billed under the 07 execution stack, not here; E5 adds only the StartExecution call, which is not separately metered.

representative_load.$comment: A busy month of autonomous evaluations; the schedule cadence dominates, so the total equals enabled_idle.
